content: Momentum calculation for swing trading: IBD RS Rating uses 40% P3 + 20% P6 + 20% P9 + 20% P12 (252-day window), designed for 12-month position holding — too long for 5-20 day swings. Production swing scanners use 20-day ROC (rate of change) as primary metric, 5-day for ultra-short momentum. RS Line = stock/ETF price divided by SPY price; rising RS line = outperformance. Industry-level RS = industry ETF ROC vs SPY ROC over same window. Swing trading practitioners target RS Rating > 80 for entries. For industry display, key metrics are: 20d ROC, above/below SMA50 (trend direction), and relative to SPY (directional bias). Lookback of 20 days matches the 5-20 day hold period — ensures momentum signal and hold period are on the same timescale.
